views.name: stone
views.title: The stone
views.caption: where it starts: a travertine slab, on a table in the sun

views.name: story-1
views.title: 1 · First touch
views.caption: tap the stone, tap its top, tap a side: a small raised platform

views.name: story-2
views.title: 2 · A traced wall
views.caption: trace across the stone from it: a wall grows along the stroke

views.name: story-3
views.title: 3 · An elevated connection
views.caption: a terrace tapped up higher; a trace from the platform's top along the wall's and up to it: landings on the wall, a step up at the end, piers where there's nothing under it

views.name: story-4
views.title: 4 · A resolved labyrinth
views.caption: a passage carved under the walkway (an arch carries it); the court walled in (paved, water, a cypress); a tower, and a trace from its top to the terrace: a bridge on one great arch (the rules' choice); every bit of dressing the rules' own

views.name: story-4-turned
views.title: From the other side
views.caption: the bridge's great arch, the passage under the walkway, the court

views.name: palette
views.title: With the palette
views.caption: the same, and pieces put by hand: a tall arch, a long bridge from its top, a pool, cypresses on the terraces

views.name: motifs
views.title: Motifs and dressing
views.caption: an arcade from the terrace to a marble tower (its bays alike, a parapet along it of its own accord); a flight run up to the terrace; the passage read as a lintel; brick, moss, ivy, lanterns and pots

views.name: motifs-turned
views.title: From the other side
views.caption: the flight up to the ivied terrace, and the arcade beyond it

views.name: dressing-close
views.title: Dressing, close
views.caption: brick and moss, the lantern on the marble tower

views.name: story-7
views.title: Auto alone, no cap
views.caption: a tower tapped up ten high (no cap on height), a walkway to it, a long wall traced round, a high walkway from halfway up the tower (its slim piers stand aside on the ways below): every motif and all the dressing the rules' own choice

views.name: story-4-plain
views.title: Without the rules' dressing
views.caption: storyboard 4 as the hand built it, with ?plain: the stone bare

views.name: sheet
views.title: The piece brush's sheet
views.caption: hold the piece brush (or touch it again): the pieces, and the dressing

views.name: select
views.title: Taken up whole
views.caption: select: a tap takes up an arch, a second its whole arcade; read it as lintels, or solid; dress it; take it away

views.name: close
views.title: The stone, close
views.caption: dressed travertine in courses, its joints staggered; pitted and banded; the light gathered under an arch

views.name: print
views.title: As a print
views.caption: print: the light hatched, closer and crossed as it darkens
